caption: ORAC: Jason. Incoming call.
speaker: Orac

caption: JASON: Already? How long was I out?
speaker: jason

caption: ORAC: Six hours. I did consider telling them you'd died, but they might have asked for the room back.
speaker: Orac

caption: JASON: Give me a second. All right. Put them through.
speaker: jason

caption: BUYER / RADIO: You're the pilot who brought an artifact back from Narcea?
speaker: bm_lewis

caption: JASON: That depends. Who gave you this channel?
speaker: jason

caption: BUYER / RADIO: The broker. I've seen your scan. Withdraw the listing. Now.
speaker: bm_lewis

caption: JASON: You haven't even made an offer.
speaker: jason

caption: BUYER / RADIO: I will. First, where did you find it? Send me the coordinates.
speaker: bm_lewis

caption: JASON: Narcea. That's as precise as I'm getting until we've agreed a price.
speaker: jason

caption: BUYER / RADIO: I need the site, not a name. Your flight log will do.
speaker: bm_lewis

caption: JASON: Then you'd have my route and I'd still have no offer.
speaker: jason

caption: BUYER / RADIO: Listen. I've spent years chasing dead ends. You have something real. Don't waste my time.
speaker: bm_lewis

caption: JASON: Then tell me what it is.
speaker: jason

caption: BUYER / RADIO: Part of a navigation system. The rest is technical. You needn't concern yourself with it.
speaker: bm_lewis

caption: JASON: I'm the one who had to carry it out. I'll decide what concerns me.
speaker: jason

caption: BUYER / RADIO: That edge isn't broken. It's a coupling face. There should be a matching piece. Did you leave anything behind?
speaker: bm_lewis

caption: JASON: Do you know where the other half is?
speaker: jason

caption: BUYER / RADIO: No. That's why I need your coordinates.
speaker: bm_lewis

caption: JASON: You need someone to go back and look. Someone who knows the way in.
speaker: jason

caption: BUYER / RADIO: Fine. Fuel, berth fees and a recovery bonus. But you leave tomorrow.
speaker: bm_lewis

caption: JASON: The Ash barely got me here. She's not making that trip again without a major rebuild.
speaker: jason

caption: BUYER / RADIO: You're being paid to collect a component, not start a war.
speaker: bm_lewis

caption: JASON: I don't get to choose what I run into out there.
speaker: jason

caption: BUYER / RADIO: Name a figure.
speaker: bm_lewis

caption: JASON: A ship. One with proper shields and something to fire back with.
speaker: jason

caption: BUYER / RADIO: For one salvage job? No.
speaker: bm_lewis

caption: JASON: Then you want a cheaper pilot. The broker can keep the listing up.
speaker: jason

caption: BUYER / RADIO: Don't. Just... give me a moment.
speaker: bm_lewis

caption: BUYER / RADIO: I have a Kestrel-class patrol courier. The Antique. She's been in bonded storage.
speaker: bm_lewis

caption: JASON: How long?
speaker: jason

caption: BUYER / RADIO: She's thirty-eight years old. Maintained, not abandoned. Don't confuse the two.
speaker: bm_lewis

caption: ORAC: Send the registry and service records, please. Not the sales brochure.
speaker: Orac

caption: BUYER / RADIO: Twin pulse cannons. Two independent shield banks. A military-rated drive. She was built to bring people home.
speaker: bm_lewis

caption: JASON: That's more than the Ash ever had. What's wrong with her?
speaker: jason

caption: BUYER / RADIO: Nothing an inspection won't settle. Bring me the complete assembly and she's yours.
speaker: bm_lewis

caption: ORAC: The records include a working autodock. That alone would be a welcome change.
speaker: Orac

caption: JASON: I have no problem docking.
speaker: jason

caption: ORAC: The dents along the Ash's port side disagree.
speaker: Orac

caption: BUYER / RADIO: Can we finish this? I need an answer.
speaker: bm_lewis

caption: JASON: I need the Antique before I leave. A reward ship won't help if I don't come back.
speaker: jason

caption: BUYER / RADIO: And what stops you taking her and disappearing?
speaker: bm_lewis

caption: JASON: The Ash. And the half I've already found.
speaker: jason

caption: BUYER / RADIO: You'll hand it over?
speaker: bm_lewis

caption: JASON: To an independent escrow agent. Sealed storage. You don't get to touch it while I'm away.
speaker: jason

caption: BUYER / RADIO: Your broken ship isn't worth much.
speaker: bm_lewis

caption: JASON: You didn't wake me up for the ship. How much is that artifact worth to you?
speaker: jason

caption: BUYER / RADIO: Enough. The agent holds both. The Antique stays registered to me until delivery.
speaker: bm_lewis

caption: ORAC: Independent inspection first. Clean title lodged with the agent. No remote shutdown, tracking feed or access to our flight logs.
speaker: Orac

caption: BUYER / RADIO: You want me to lend you a ship with no way to take it back?
speaker: bm_lewis

caption: JASON: You have collateral. I'm not flying something you can switch off because I miss a call.
speaker: jason

caption: BUYER / RADIO: All right. Fuel and berth fees are covered. We agree a return date before you leave.
speaker: bm_lewis

caption: JASON: And a communications grace period. Narcea doesn't exactly have reliable service.
speaker: jason

caption: ORAC: A missed call is not default. Any dispute goes through the agent, not an automatic seizure.
speaker: Orac

caption: JASON: If I bring back the match, the agent releases both pieces to you and transfers the Antique to me.
speaker: jason

caption: BUYER / RADIO: And if you don't?
speaker: bm_lewis

caption: JASON: I return the Antique. The agent returns the Ash and my artifact. You still pay for the search.
speaker: jason

caption: BUYER / RADIO: You're being paid to look, yes. You don't get to keep my ship for trying.
speaker: bm_lewis

caption: ORAC: And the agent verifies the collateral value covers the loan. Loss and default terms in writing, before anything changes hands.
speaker: Orac

caption: BUYER / RADIO: Agreed. Now send the site.
speaker: bm_lewis

caption: JASON: No coordinates. No flight logs. You're buying what I recover, not the route.
speaker: jason

caption: BUYER / RADIO: I could send a team. You'd be safer.
speaker: bm_lewis

caption: JASON: You could send a team without me. That's why you're not getting the coordinates.
speaker: jason

caption: BUYER / RADIO: Keep them, then. But contact me directly if you find anything else. No brokers.
speaker: bm_lewis

caption: JASON: Send the contract to the agent. Once the inspection passes and the advance clears, we can exchange the collateral and the keys.
speaker: jason

caption: BUYER / RADIO: Send your terms. Tonight. I've waited long enough.
speaker: bm_lewis

caption: JASON: Call ended?
speaker: jason

caption: ORAC: Ended. No coordinates or flight logs sent.
speaker: Orac

caption: JASON: You really want that autodock, don't you?
speaker: jason

caption: ORAC: I'm an advanced intelligence, not your flight computer. You could ask me to interface with the controls occasionally.
speaker: Orac

caption: JASON: I'm a pilot. I like flying.
speaker: jason

caption: ORAC: I know. I travel in a box. I like arriving intact.
speaker: Orac

caption: JASON: I need to talk to Stacy before we leave.
speaker: jason

caption: ORAC: I'll prepare a message. The return course can wait.
speaker: Orac

caption: JASON: Tell me we're clear.
speaker: jason

caption: ORAC: Of the ring. Keep climbing.
speaker: Orac

caption: JASON: I wasn't planning to stop.
speaker: jason

caption: JASON: Same course?
speaker: jason

caption: ORAC: Same course. There's still a very great deal of nothing between us and the station.
speaker: Orac

caption: JASON: Good. Wake me when that changes.
speaker: jason

caption: STATION / RADIO: Ash, you're cleared for Berth Four. Follow the amber markers.
speaker: am_michael

caption: JASON: Berth Four. Any chance of a bed that isn't attached to an engine?
speaker: jason

caption: STATION / RADIO: If you can pay for it.
speaker: am_michael
